# gsm_image_registry_credential (Resource)

Manages a credential that game servers use to pull images from a private registry. The credential belongs to a project, or to an environment when `environment_id` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gsm_project_secret" "registry" {
  project_id  = "<project_id>"
  secret_name = "registry"

  kv = {
    password          = "<registry_token>"
    access-key-id     = "<aws_access_key_id>"
    secret-access-key = "<aws_secret_access_key>"
  }
}

# Project credential with a static token
resource "gsm_image_registry_credential" "token" {
  project_id           = "<project_id>"
  name                 = "game-images"
  registry_url_pattern = "registry.example.com"

  auth {
    token = "!ref:secret:${gsm_project_secret.registry.secret_name}:password"
  }
}

# Environment credential for AWS ECR
resource "gsm_image_registry_credential" "ecr" {
  project_id           = "<project_id>"
  environment_id       = "<environment_id>"
  name                 = "game-ecr"
  registry_url_pattern = "123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-2.amazonaws.com"

  auth {
    aws_ecr {
      region            = "ap-northeast-2"
      role_arn          = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/docs-registry"
      access_key_id     = "!ref:secret:${gsm_project_secret.registry.secret_name}:access-key-id"
      secret_access_key = "!ref:secret:${gsm_project_secret.registry.secret_name}:secret-access-key"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth` (Block List, Min: 1) Authentication methods. Each entry sets exactly one of `token` and `aws_ecr`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--auth))
- `name` (String) Name of the credential
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the credential belongs
- `registry_url_pattern` (String) Registry URL prefix that the credential applies to, e.g. `123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-2.amazonaws.com`. Wildcards are not allowed.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. When set, the credential belongs to the environment instead of the project.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Optional:

- `aws_ecr` (Block List, Max: 1) AWS ECR authentication (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--auth--aws_ecr))
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret reference to a registry token (`!ref:secret:<name>:<key>`)

<a id="nestedblock--auth--aws_ecr"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth.aws_ecr`

Required:

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Secret reference to the AWS access key ID (`!ref:secret:<name>:<key>`)
- `region` (String) AWS region of the registry
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role assumed to pull images
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret reference to the AWS secret access key (`!ref:secret:<name>:<key>`)
